ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached graph plots water level in centimeters against time in hours from 0 to 24. method.method_draft: Inspect the graph of water level versus hour. Draw or imagine the horizontal line at 30 cm, then read the hours where the curve crosses this level: about 4 h, 11 h, 14 h, and 20 h. The curve is above 30 cm from 4 to 11 and again from 14 to 20. Add the durations: 11−4=7 hours and 20−14=6 hours, giving 13 hours total.

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the coordinate graph: x-axis is hours 0–24, y-axis is water level in cm, and the curve crosses the 30 cm line at approximately hours 4, 11, 14, and 20.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A quantity is over a threshold exactly on the portions of its graph lying above the corresponding horizontal line; total time is found by summing the lengths of those x-intervals.
